turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sanibonani. Le module izosifundisa kabanzi ngokubaluleka kokwenza abafundi bayiqondisise into abayifundayo.
turns.en: Hello. This module will teach us in detail about the importance of making learners understand what they are reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Uke uzithole ufunda indaba uze uyiqede kodwa ungazi ukuthi ikhuluma ngani?
turns.en: Do you sometimes find yourself reading a story until you finish it but you do not know what it is talking about?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Lapho wena njengothisha ucabanga ukuthi indaba bayayilandela baze baphendule nemibuzo kanti abakuqondi.
turns.en: Where you as a teacher think that they are following the story until they even answer questions yet they do not understand.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: baze bephendule nemibuzo kanti abakuqondi abakufundayo.
turns.en: until they even answer questions yet they do not understand what they are reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi wazi izindlela ezenza umfundi akuqondisise lokho akufundayo aze afinyelele ekuphenduleni imibuzo.
turns.en: That is why it is important that you know ways that make a learner understand what they are reading until they reach answering questions.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: After finishing the work of this module, you will be able

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukuqonda ukuthi siyini isifundo sokuqondisisa nokubaluleka kwaso.
turns.en: to understand what a comprehension lesson is and its importance.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: To discuss ways of improving comprehension,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: and at which it is done.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: hension and at what time it is done.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Nokukhombisa ukuqonda ukuthi ungakufundisa kanjani ukuqondisisa.
turns.en: And to show understanding of how you can teach comprehension.
